title: Qt: Add a preference to force Color Scheme (Light/Dark Mode)
description:
Qt 6.8 added the appropriate hooks to be able to force dark
or light mode independent of the current system default.

It doesn't work on all platforms (see #18246) but does work
on Windows (and I believe macOS).

Fix #19328
